newsitem.title: USA: National Computer Systems sets acquisition.
newsitem.headline: National Computer Systems sets acquisition.

text.p: National Computer Systems Inc said Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Virtual University Enterprises, a Bloomington, Minn.-based electronic course registration and training administration company, for 582,000 shares of common stock.

The company also said its board authorized the repurchase of up to one million shares of common stock to offset shares issued in connection with the acquisition as well as stock-based employee plans and future acquisitions.
It said the acquisition, expected to be completed within 30 days, should have no material impact to fiscal 1997 earnings estimates.

Chairman Russell Gullotti said the Virtual University Enterprises acquisition will extend National Computer's established position "in the education industry into the fast growing electronic course registration and electronic testing markets."
